items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, who did you hear when you were coming up though, i mean, before Hodges?

ctx.x: Yeah, you never did know him though, huh? Bechet? Yeah. No, Cindy Bechet. Yeah. No, I think he left there before I even got a teenager. I guess. Yeah. Well, you knew his brother, I guess. Yeah. Leonard. Yeah, I knew his brother. Yeah, I knew his brother. Just like Big O, I didn't know about him, but I knew his brother. Yeah. Some guys left me all before I was up in my teens.
Well, who did you hear when you were coming up though, I mean, before Hodges? You must have heard some different people when you were a kid here.
Well, we had like old Fess. I can't think of him. He's a New Orleans born too. He was playing with Count. We call him Fess. He died a while back.
